# agentops_outpost (Resource)

An outpost that proxies agent traffic from a remote network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable outpost name.

### Optional

- `allowlist` (Attributes List) Upstream endpoints the outpost is allowed to reach. Replaced wholesale on every apply: removing the blocks (or setting `allowlist = []`) clears the allowlist, which leaves the outpost able to reach nothing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowlist))
- `description` (String) Free-form description. Removing it from config clears the stored description.
- `labels` (Map of String) Arbitrary key/value labels. Replaced wholesale on every apply: removing the map (or setting `labels = {}`) clears them.

### Read-Only

- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the outpost is currently connected.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `credential` (String, Sensitive) Enrollment credential returned once at creation. Never returned on subsequent reads.
- `credential_hint` (String) Safe-to-display hint for the credential.
- `id` (String) Outpost identifier.
- `status` (String) Enrollment status (`PENDING`, `ENROLLED`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--allowlist"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allowlist`

Required:

- `host` (String) Hostname or IP address.
- `port` (Number) Port number.
- `scheme` (String) URL scheme (`http` or `https`).

Optional:

- `path_prefix` (String) Optional path prefix.
